updates.title: 230 Wishlists & QOL Update
updates.content:
Hey Employee #200 869 567,

We just passed 230 Wishlists for Diversion! Super exciting.

During Steam Next Fest we almost 6x the Wishlists and we still got time until the full release! Spread the word, the company will compensate.

After some Youtubers played the game a bunch of QOL and bug fixes was added, should be now more polished than ever!

Next up 1,000 Wishlists! 🧸
Thanks for everyone's support! ❤️

🎮 Follow us on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5401660/Diversion_Demo/)

👾 Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/Ufjk299cDz)
